profile.headline: SDE at Amazon
profile.summary:
My goal is to develop useful applications. I believe one of the most satisfying aspects of being a programmer is seeing code you wrote deployed in a live system and used by real people, especially if it improves their lives in some way. I look forward to utilizing my background in psychology and programming to deliver technical solutions and continue to innovate.

Languages: Golang, Kotlin, Java, C#, Angular, React, C++, HTML5, CSS3, Javascript (Node)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and launched a high-scale commendation service handling 70M+ daily player interactions across multiple game titles, maintaining sub-100ms latency globally
• Developed an automated bulk moderation system that increased operational efficiency by 90%, processing 250,000+ cases and significantly reducing time-to-action
• Owned the GDPR compliance service that orchestrated data collection across multiple services, aggregating user information into a single file, ensuring timely and comprehensive responses to data subject access requests

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and designed a payroll admin tool that would automate paying referral bonuses and keep an audit log. This tool increased reliability and saved the payroll team from manually inputting data biweekly
- Released an internally public golang SDK to allow external teams to quickly integrate with employee data
- Streamlined the process for onboarding new data streams into the data pipeline decreasing engineering time to add new data sources while increasing reliability
- Added an eventing architecture to validate if daily job process ran correctly and would notify users of results
- Refactored a go api into node to promote cross team collaboration and enable code sharing between the front and back end teams

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop and maintain an internal enterprise application that provides visibility and monitoring into Azure services and offerings. Allows project managers to keep track of progress and ensure internal and global compliance requirements. Data is aggregated from various data sources like Cosmos, Data Lakes, and Kusto.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a customizable dashboard and data aggregator website to assist Boeing exec in making decisions
- Wrote React to display various related metrics in a simple to consume and customizable website
- Wrote Kotlin to reduce cost by automating data aggregation that would be used in the front end
- Set up and maintained CI/CD pipeline through Pivotal Cloud Foundry
- Refactored thymeleaf templating front end into React through test driven development with mocha/chai
- Followed kanban methodology and tracked stories and issues through Jira
- Interviewed potential hires to see if they were adaptable in a TDD environment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a restful api that hit various microservices to gather and store data pertaining to an chatting platform
- Refactored monolithic golang backend into several microservices communicating through grpc
- Set up docker containers to run the microservices
- Set up various AWS technologies to host the application (ecs, aurora, elb)
- Imported datadog as middleware to enable tracing to keep microservice maintenance less difficult
- Maintained and wrote unit tests to get at least 80% test coverage
- Interviewed potential software engineers to see if they would be a good fit for RV
- Mentored junior engineers on various back end best practices
